events.title: Next Fest is LIVE! Mod support and an even juicier demo!
events.summary: Grazed is in Steam Next Fest! 🎉 Next Fest is live, and the Grazed demo is free to play right now. Grazed is a fast-paced arcade roguelite packed with juice. Every run starts slow, then your combo snowballs: hundreds of slices, explosions, axes, lightning and black holes, until the whole screen is pure chaos. Die, upgrade, and come back stronger.
